tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Full evidence and connection details for one service, plus a referral_id. Use the referral_id with report_outcome after you use the service (valid 7 days).

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Individual check results for a service over the last days, newest first. Use it to see patterns (intermittent failures, slowdowns) behind the summary figures.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Recently detected changes to monitored documentation and API schemas, across all reviewed services or for one. A detected change is pending interpretation, not necessarily a breaking change.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: How many services we track and how many checks ran in the last 24 hours.

tools.description: The weekly State of Agent Services report: coverage, probe results, payment networks, prices and purpose tags across everything we track. Counts and distributions only, with their method. Omit id for the latest published report; 'current' gives provisional week-to-date figures.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: report_outcome, send_feedback · Private data: search_services, report_outcome, send_feedback · Public sink: report_outcome, send_feedback · Destructive: get_tree.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: report_outcome, send_feedback · Private data: search_services, report_outcome, send_feedback · Public sink: report_outcome, send_feedback · Destructive: get_tree

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
